watchFor: 找出水流路徑與機械軸的能量傳遞方向。

courses.overview: 從「長江三峽大壩工程」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Three Gorges Dam Engineering into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.whyEn: Compare Three Gorges Dam Engineering with Hoover Dam: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transfer: 大型水壩都需把地質基礎、混凝土溫控、水流與水輪發電介面共同評估。
related.transferEn: Large dams coordinate geological foundations, concrete temperature control, flow and turbine-generator interfaces.
related.difference: 胡佛壩為拱重力壩；三峽為重力壩，峽谷形狀、受力途徑、泄洪和航運條件不同。
related.differenceEn: Hoover is an arch-gravity dam and Three Gorges a gravity dam, differing in valley shape, load paths, spillway and navigation conditions.
practice: 畫出向兩岸與向基礎傳力的差別
比較大體積混凝土熱量管理
列出不能依壩高直接推估的效能
practiceEn: Compare load transfer toward abutments and foundations
List performance that dam height alone cannot predict

courses.summary: 三峽工程適合用「一個水利樞紐，多種相互牽動的功能」來閱讀：大壩、水庫、電站與通航設施需要共同運作。三斗坪的地理位置讓學徒能從河流尺度理解工地，而不是只看一座混凝土構造物。工程課程也應把長期維護、上下游使用者與環境影響列入問題清單。
courses.summaryEn: The Three Gorges project is best read as one water-control complex with interacting functions: the dam, reservoir, power station and navigation facilities operate together. Its Sandouping location lets learners consider the river scale rather than only a concrete structure. Long-term maintenance, upstream and downstream users, and environmental effects also belong in the engineering questions.

history.title: 工程正式開工
history.text: 三峽集團記載，工程於1994年12月14日正式開工。這是理解大型分期工程的起點：施工準備、河道處理與永久設施並非同時完成，時間線需要顯示各階段的依賴。
history.textEn: China Three Gorges records the formal start of construction on 14 December 1994. It provides a starting point for studying phased works: preparation, river management and permanent facilities are not completed simultaneously, so the timeline must reveal dependencies.

history.title: 蓄水、通航與發電進入新階段
history.titleEn: Impoundment, navigation and power enter a new phase
history.text: 2003年完成二期工程蓄水、通航與發電目標。三項里程碑放在同一年，不代表它們是同一個動作；課程可分別畫出水庫、船閘及機組的功能介面，討論跨系統驗證。
history.textEn: In 2003 the project achieved its second-phase goals for impoundment, navigation and power generation. Occurring in one year does not make these a single operation. Learners can map reservoir, lock and generating-unit interfaces separately to discuss verification across systems.

history.title: 主發電機組全部投運
history.titleEn: All main generating units enter operation
history.text: 長江電力的工程介紹記載，2012年7月全部32台70萬千瓦主機組投入運行。從1994年的開工走到機組陸續投運，顯示大型基礎設施往往以分期建造、分期使用的方式形成。
history.textEn: China Yangtze Power records all 32 main 700 MW generating units entering operation in July 2012. The interval from the 1994 start to successive unit commissioning illustrates how large infrastructure can be built and brought into use in phases.

courses.connection: 可連到抽蓄水力、船閘、河港與跨河橋梁。先用水位與能量的示意模型區分發電、調蓄及船舶通過的目的，再比較不同操作情境的限制。工程成功的討論應同時提出結構安全、設備可靠性與河川系統影響的證據需求。
courses.connectionEn: Related topics include pumped storage, navigation locks, river ports and bridges. Begin with schematic water-level and energy models to distinguish generation, storage and vessel passage, then compare constraints under different operating scenarios. Evaluating success should identify evidence needs for structural safety, equipment reliability and effects on the river system.
